technique_name: Summarize what you know about the Industrial Revolution
description: The Industrial Revolution was a period of time in the 18th and 19th centuries marked by a shift from manual labor and methods of production to automated processes and machinery. This change in production had a wide-reaching economic,political, and social impact, enabling mass production of goods, leading to a rise in urbanization, and increasing prosperity.
